titulo: ORACIÓN DE LA MAÑANA 🚌 | Cinco de la mañana en el primer bus
texto_gancho: Cinco de la mañana en el primer bus

escenas.texto: Padre, son las cinco de la mañana de un miércoles y ya voy en el primer bus al trabajo.
y en mi casa todos siguen dormidos.
Antes de que empiece la prisa, quiero darte gracias.
Gracias porque tengo trabajo, aunque sea lejos y cansado.
Gracias por estas piernas que me llevan y por este asiento que hoy sí conseguí.
Tu palabra dice que de mañana oyes mi voz, y aquí está la mía, entre el ruido del motor.
Cuida mi casa mientras no estoy.
Cuida a mis hijos en la escuela y a mi esposa en su día.
Dame paciencia con el jefe y fuerzas para las horas de pie.
Y que nadie en este bus se sienta solo hoy.
Te pido también por el chofer, que madrugó más que todos nosotros.
Este viaje es largo, pero no lo hago sin ti.
En el nombre de Jesús. Amén.
Dale like, escribe AMÉN si sales de casa antes del sol, y envíasela a quien hoy madrugó para trabajar.

import React from 'react';
import {AbsoluteFill} from 'remotion';
import {useS,en,interpolate,clamp,DUR} from './kit';

// Primer bus del miércoles. Cuatro tomas dibujadas para este guion.
// Sin SFX ni texto: el render FE incorpora voz, música y subtítulos.
const blend=(s:number,t:number)=>interpolate(s,[t-1.6,t+1.6],[0,1],clamp);

  <ellipse cx={-164} cy={350} rx={70} ry={30} fill="#23262a"/><ellipse cx={210} cy={341} rx={72} ry={30} fill="#23262a"/>
  <g transform={`translate(0 ${Math.sin(s*1.7)*2.8})`}>
    <path d="M-170 90Q-200 -120 -135 -270Q-80 -315 100 -280Q175 -250 177 90Z" fill="url(#chaqueta)"/>
    <path d="M-139 -265L-165 40M108 -265L142 40" stroke="#dbd9af" strokeWidth={27}/>
    <path d="M-172 -88H170" stroke="#d2d4c0" strokeWidth={28}/>
    <path d="M-125 -246Q-245 -175 -200 -90L-65 -30M125 -243Q237 -153 179 -85L64 -30" fill="none" stroke="#cd692e" strokeWidth={65} strokeLinecap="round"/>

    <ellipse cx={0} cy={-413} rx={93} ry={112} fill="url(#piel)"/>
    <path d="M-92 -424Q-108 -545 4 -536Q110 -536 91 -410L63 -464Q0 -498 -64 -461Z" fill="#a8a9a2"/>
    <path d="M-85 -450Q-57 -484 -18 -477M37 -477Q65 -471 82 -445" fill="none" stroke="#d3d0bd" strokeWidth={7}/>
    {[-34,32].map(x=><g key={x}><path d={`M${x-14} -425Q${x} -435 ${x+14} -425`} stroke="#46392e" strokeWidth={5} fill="none"/><circle cx={x} cy={-413} r={8} fill="#191815"/><circle cx={x-2} cy={-416} r={2.6} fill="#fff1d0"/></g>)}
    <path d="M2 -409Q23 -382 7 -378" stroke="#59392b" strokeWidth={5} fill="none"/>
    <path d={`M-26 -355Q0 ${-348+blend(s,en('asiento'))*8} 29 -355`} stroke="#493029" strokeWidth={5} fill="none" strokeLinecap="round"/>
    <rect x={-51} y={-130} width={104} height={160} rx={24} fill="url(#termo)"/>
    <rect x={-55} y={-146} width={112} height={34} rx={11} fill="#323b43"/>
    <circle cx={-62} cy={-42} r={32} fill="url(#piel)"/><circle cx={63} cy={-41} r={32} fill="url(#piel)"/>
    {[0,1,2].map(i=><path key={i} d={`M${-24+i*25} -152Q${-50+i*25+Math.sin(s+i)*15} -195 ${-20+i*25} -240`} fill="none" stroke="#f9e8ce" strokeWidth={5} opacity={.25+.1*Math.sin(s+i)}/>)}
    <path d="M-160 -270Q-200 -130 -170 75" fill="none" stroke="#ffcf94" strokeWidth={7} opacity={.65}/>
  </g>
</g>;

const Ventana:React.FC<{s:number;dia:number}>=({s,dia})=><g>
  <rect x={45} y={430} width={990} height={750} rx={70} fill="#0b1b34"/>
  <rect x={55} y={440} width={970} height={730} rx={60} fill="url(#amanecer)" opacity={dia}/>
  <circle cx={850} cy={1050-dia*220} r={110} fill="#ffdb9c" opacity={dia}/>
  {[0,1,2,3,4,5,6].map(i=><g key={i} transform={`translate(${((i*230-s*24)%1610+1610)%1610-270} 0)`}>
    <rect y={750+(i%3)*55} width={185} height={480} fill={i%2?'#273348':'#172839'}/>
    {[0,1,2].map(j=><rect key={j} x={30+j*44} y={820+(i%3)*55} width={20} height={36} fill="#d6b77a" opacity={.3}/>)}</g>)}
  {[0,1,2].map(i=><g key={i} transform={`translate(${((i*460-s*80)%1380+1380)%1380-100} 0)`}><path d="M0 1170V690Q0 640 70 650" stroke="#515968" strokeWidth={14} fill="none"/><ellipse cx={75} cy={655} rx={42} ry={12} fill="#ffdfa0"/><path d="M60 670L-20 1120H170L90 670Z" fill="#f2ce87" opacity={.06}/></g>)}
  <path d="M80 475L900 1110M250 445L1020 1010" stroke="#d3d9d2" strokeWidth={22} opacity={.08}/>
  <rect x={45} y={430} width={990} height={750} rx={70} fill="none" stroke="#717c80" strokeWidth={28}/>
  <path d="M570 440V1170" stroke="#5f6c73" strokeWidth={21}/>
</g>;

const Casa:React.FC<{s:number}>=({s})=><g>
  <rect x={110} y={510} width={860} height={800} rx={26} fill="#574d47"/>
  <path d="M110 710H970M560 510V1310" stroke="#d3b898" strokeWidth={14}/>
  <rect x={160} y={880} width={350} height={310} rx={24} fill="#846b62"/>
  {[0,1].map(i=><g key={i} transform={`translate(${245+i*150} 970)`}><ellipse cy={60} rx={65} ry={85} fill={i?'#93a8a6':'#b09981'}/><ellipse cy={-24} rx={43} ry={50} fill="#a86f4f"/><path d="M-43 -35Q-30 -90 25 -70L43 -28" fill="#34302a"/><path d="M-26 -20l15 3M8 -17l15 -3" stroke="#32291f" strokeWidth={4}/></g>)}
  <path d="M150 1050Q320 1010 515 1060V1210H150Z" fill="#c5b09a"/>
  <g transform={`translate(755 ${1000+Math.sin(s)*2})`}><path d="M-75 150L-63 -45Q0 -85 60 -45L80 150Z" fill="#77896a"/><ellipse cy={-110} rx={59} ry={73} fill="#bd8b68"/><path d="M-60 -100Q-75 -210 30 -190Q92 -175 62 -80L35 -135L-40 -135Z" fill="#382b27"/><path d="M-50 -25L-115 80M45 -30L85 80" stroke="#77896a" strokeWidth={35} strokeLinecap="round"/><circle cx={-115} cy={80} r={20} fill="#bd8b68"/><circle cx={85} cy={80} r={20} fill="#bd8b68"/></g>
  <rect x={590} y={1100} width={340} height={30} rx={10} fill="#ba9870"/><rect x={615} y={1030} width={120} height={72} rx={12} fill="#c7a564"/><rect x={765} y={1030} width={120} height={72} rx={12} fill="#9cae9a"/>
</g>;

const Chofer:React.FC<{s:number;dia:number}>=({s,dia})=><g>
  <path d="M20 460H1060L980 1250H100Z" fill="#182938"/>
  <g transform="translate(0 -140)"><Ventana s={s*.6} dia={dia}/></g>
  <rect x={340} y={410} width={400} height={180} rx={55} fill="#747f80"/>
  <rect x={357} y={427} width={366} height={146} rx={40} fill="#b9c1b8"/>
  <ellipse cx={540} cy={520} rx={53} ry={61} fill="#a37454"/>
  <path d="M480 494Q490 433 550 455L601 494Z" fill="#334557"/>
  {[-21,21].map(x=><g key={x}><circle cx={540+x} cy={512} r={6} fill="#191b1a"/><circle cx={538+x} cy={510} r={2} fill="#fff7df"/></g>)}
  <path d="M210 1620L250 1250Q420 1160 590 1280L670 1700Z" fill="#596a76"/>
  <ellipse cx={405} cy={1130} rx={97} ry={115} fill="#a2a59b"/><path d="M295 1090Q302 967 450 1000L511 1090Z" fill="#334557"/>
  <ellipse cx={740} cy={1370} rx={175} ry={110} fill="none" stroke="#1b232b" strokeWidth={40}/>
  <path d="M528 1300L640 1355M602 1510L835 1380" stroke="#596a76" strokeWidth={56} strokeLinecap="round"/>
  <circle cx={640} cy={1355} r={29} fill="#a37454"/><circle cx={835} cy={1380} r={29} fill="#a37454"/>
</g>;

export const Escena:React.FC=()=>{
  const {s}=useS();
  const dia=blend(s,en('gracias'))*.25+blend(s,en('chofer'))*.75;
  const detalle=blend(s,en('Antes'));
  const casa=blend(s,en('Cuida'))*(1-blend(s,en('nadie')));
  const conductor=blend(s,en('Te'));
  const botas=blend(s,en('horas'))*(1-blend(s,en('nadie')));
  return <AbsoluteFill style={{background:'#1a2330'}}><svg viewBox="0 0 1080 1920" width="100%" height="100%">
    <defs>
      <linearGradient id="amanecer" x2="0" y2="1"><stop stopColor="#657890"/><stop offset=".55" stopColor="#dc9b86"/><stop offset="1" stopColor="#f4d3a2"/></linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="chaqueta"><stop stopColor="#ef9a4c"/><stop offset="1" stopColor="#a95129"/></linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="piel"><stop stopColor="#ad7a53"/><stop offset="1" stopColor="#694430"/></linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="termo"><stop stopColor="#adb7b5"/><stop offset=".4" stopColor="#e0ded0"/><stop offset="1" stopColor="#667776"/></linearGradient>
      <radialGradient id="luz"><stop stopColor="#ffe4ad" stopOpacity=".34"/><stop offset="1" stopColor="#ffe4ad" stopOpacity="0"/></radialGradient>
      <radialGradient id="vineta"><stop offset=".5" stopColor="#070e17" stopOpacity="0"/><stop offset="1" stopColor="#070e17" stopOpacity=".6"/></radialGradient>
    </defs>
    <g transform={`translate(${Math.sin(s*.16)*11} ${Math.cos(s*.19)*9}) translate(540 1050) scale(${1.025+Math.sin(s*.23)*.015}) translate(-540 -1050)`}>
      <rect width={1080} height={1920} fill="#34414a"/>
      <path d="M0 390H1080M0 1250H1080" stroke="#a59777" strokeWidth={22}/>
      <Ventana s={s} dia={dia}/>
      <rect x={160} y={1190} width={700} height={550} rx={80} fill="#485a67"/><path d="M195 1225Q500 1200 825 1240" stroke="#728491" strokeWidth={11} fill="none"/>
      <g opacity={1-conductor}>
        <g transform={`translate(540 1120) scale(${1+detalle*.55}) translate(-540 -1120)`}><Obrero s={s}/></g>
        <g opacity={casa*.85}><Casa s={s}/></g>
        <g opacity={botas} transform={`translate(${Math.sin(s)*4} 0)`}><ellipse cx={430} cy={1580} rx={135} ry={55} fill="#46382c"/><ellipse cx={700} cy={1570} rx={135} ry={55} fill="#46382c"/><path d="M340 1540V1410H465L500 1560M610 1540V1410H735L770 1560" fill="#705a41"/><path d="M345 1480H465M615 1480H735" stroke="#b49865" strokeWidth={8}/></g>
        <g opacity={blend(s,en('nadie'))} transform="translate(930 1300) scale(.56)"><Obrero s={s+2}/></g>
      </g>
      <g opacity={conductor}><Chofer s={s} dia={dia}/></g>
      <path d="M70 370L650 370L1080 1730H660Z" fill="#ffe6b3" opacity={.035+dia*.055}/>
      <ellipse cx={330} cy={950} rx={650} ry={1000} fill="url(#luz)" opacity={.6+dia*.4}/>
      {Array.from({length:26},(_,i)=><circle key={i} cx={80+(i*137+s*(3+i%3))%920} cy={420+((i*197-s*(5+i%4))%1150+1150)%1150} r={2+i%3} fill="#fce9c2" opacity={.12+.08*Math.sin(s*.5+i)}/>)}
    </g>
    <rect width={1080} height={1920} fill="url(#vineta)"/>
  </svg></AbsoluteFill>;
};
